status: unverified existing-hardware composition; not declared impossible or hardware extension; capacity novelty alone fails a stronger cross-layer baseline
request: Pack sixteen experts, four down depths each, into one existing 64-depth MVMU with same output-row range.
positive_evidence: Original mvm text opcode contains depth, stacks, precision, isLast; source forms depth-serial accumulated matrix operations.
NVSim LPDecoder models existing wordline reuse/shift; no new context is requested by sequential expert GEMVs.
missing_specific_contract: Whether an MVM group can start at nonzero depth while selecting only four physical depths.
Whether isLast performs ADC readout and clears the analog accumulator, or reset is implicitly tied to depth zero / sequence start.
How multiple logical matrices are programmed into depth-offset ranges of one MVMU and selected by the weight binary ABI.
How numerical QA-ADC scaling/precision depends on a partial depth range.
read_depth: Full public compiler opcode construction/serialization, register allocation references, relevant NVSim timing/config source. Original MICRO2022 full paper still not obtained; author homepage and HPCS primary publication pages provide metadata but no visible preprint link. Detailed source and access boundaries are in depth_sources.json.
why_no_conclusion: Public repository has no instruction executor or numerical accumulator/reset implementation. isLast references are compiler graph/register-allocation metadata and code serialization, insufficient to infer physical clear semantics.
experiment_scope: Current mapping study conservatively retains original one ConstantMatrixTile per MVMU/core. It does not claim that this policy is a fundamental hardware capacity bound or that depth-offset packing would require new hardware.
why_no_numerical_offset_demo: A CPU interpreter that clears on isLast would choose the missing semantics, not verify the published hardware. Reset-on-isLast and reset-on-depth-zero both agree with the compiler's existing zero-start groups, yet can disagree when a new independent group starts at a nonzero depth. No hardware proof or emulated reset claim is made.
minimal_required_existing_contract: Absolute selected WL/depth address is independent of the group's logical first/last index and ADC scale.
Independent MVM groups reset or otherwise isolate accumulation even when the first absolute depth is nonzero.
Weight programming associates a matrix's local column chunk with an arbitrary disjoint physical depth range, while retaining one original accumulator and one input register bank per core.
A legal existing control sequence and its random-depth select/clear cost are documented; codegen field values alone are insufficient.

strong_baseline_capacity_counterexample.assumption: Conditional geometry only, single-token DNN layers execute sequentially; native absolute depth/reset/programming remains unverified.
strong_baseline_capacity_counterexample.granite3: A route-oblivious cross-DNN-layer packing uses exactly1152 cores, saturates all73728/64 slots, and has at most one tile per DNN layer/phase in a core. GU and down core pools are disjoint. No anti-coactivation learning is needed to attain capacity floor or avoid same-phase route collisions.
strong_baseline_capacity_counterexample.granite4tiny: Expert geometry alone needs at least5760 cores, exceeding original224*24=5376. Depth packing does not establish a full40-layer fit.

direct_prior: 3D-aCortex arXiv1908.02472 Section4.3 already packs kernels in the third dimension; Sections2.1,2.2,4.2 explicitly describe layer selection and capacitor reset in its own architecture.

IBM US20240086682A1, published2024-03-14, explicitly maps different experts to different tiers, includes3D NAND as an embodiment, and sequentially executes selected experts with gated output accumulation. This does not prove the same control exists in3D-FPIM.
decision: Do not claim native depth co-packing established, do not claim MoE-tier storage novel, and do not credit capacity fit over the one-tile-per-core compiler policy as a paper contribution. A future experiment first needs the native contract, then a resource/workload advantage over route-oblivious cross-layer dense packing and conventional communication-aware packing at identical depth capacity.
